subject.title: Feature Request: Token Efficiency & Agent UX Improvements (Agent Perspective)

question: Which canonical surface should own the remaining token-efficiency/context-selection and metadata-privacy work, and should OpenClaw add a public bootstrap selection contract?
rationale: The code gaps are real, but the remaining work changes prompt/session context, public config semantics, and security-sensitive metadata handling across several already-open trackers.

options.title: Split Across Canonical Trackers
options.body: Use #46565/#13968 for bootstrap and HEARTBEAT.md behavior, #39847/#50520 for outbound metadata privacy, and close only the already-implemented slices inside this umbrella.

options.title: Sponsor One Bootstrap Contract
options.body: Create a unified maintainer design for safe dynamic context, session-scoped file selection, and cache-stable time/heartbeat behavior before landing overlapping point fixes.

options.title: Reject Core Expansion
options.body: Keep core bootstrap behavior narrow and route optional token-efficiency workflows to plugins or ClawHub, then close this umbrella after documenting that product decision.

recommendation.title: Split Across Canonical Trackers
recommendation.body: Use #46565/#13968 for bootstrap and HEARTBEAT.md behavior, #39847/#50520 for outbound metadata privacy, and close only the already-implemented slices inside this umbrella.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available owner signal from heartbeat, subagent bootstrap, and related maintainer-side context decisions.
